@router.post("/sso/saml/organizations/{org_id}/sync-profile")
async def sync_saml_user_profile(
    org_id: str,
    request: Request,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)
):
    req_data = await prepare_fastapi_request_for_saml(request)
    auth = OneLogin_Saml2_Auth(req_data, await get_saml_settings_for_org(org_id, db))
    auth.process_response()

    if auth.get_errors():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid SAML response")

    name_id = auth.get_nameid()
    attrs = auth.get_attributes()

    user = await db.scalar(
        select(User).where(User.email == name_id, User.org_id == org_id)
    )
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="User record not found in specified organization")

    user.job_title = attrs.get("title", [user.job_title])[0]
    user.phone_number = attrs.get("telephoneNumber", [user.phone_number])[0]
    user.department = attrs.get("department", [user.department])[0]
    await db.commit()

    return {"status": "profile_synced", "user_id": str(user.id)}
